releaseNotes.zh-CN: 恢复菜单窗口使用 macOS 系统默认背景透明效果，取消额外叠加的半透明背景。优化应用内更新说明：跨越多个版本升级时会累计显示当前版本之后的全部更新，并新增中英文完整更新历史页面；发布流程同时保留历史 appcast 项并校验更新记录连续性。
releaseNotes.en: Restores the menu window's default macOS background translucency by removing the additional translucent overlay. Improves in-app release notes so upgrades spanning multiple versions show every change after the installed build, adds bilingual changelog pages, and strengthens appcast history retention and release continuity checks.
